moments.title: Premier League Pre-Season Heats Up
moments.blurb: Clubs across the UK are in the thick of their pre-season friendlies this week, gearing up for the 2026/27 Premier League season which kicks off on August 21st.

angles.name: General Buzz
angles.copy: Pre-season is in full swing! Who are you backing to shine when the Premier League proper kicks off on August 21st? Our teams are putting in the work.

angles.name: Local Focus (Exeter/Devon)
angles.copy: Bournemouth are in action today against Real Betis – just one of many Premier League teams getting their final pre-season tests in. Who are you hoping to see make a big impact this season?

moments.title: Community Shield Showdown in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 Community Shield will see Premier League champions Arsenal take on FA Cup holders Manchester City at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: National Preview
angles.copy: The first silverware of the season is up for grabs! Arsenal face Manchester City in the Community Shield next Sunday in Cardiff. Who's taking home the trophy?

angles.name: Welsh Local Angle
angles.copy: Cardiff is hosting the Community Shield next Sunday as Arsenal and Manchester City battle it out at the Principality Stadium! Who are you cheering for?

moments.title: Hockey World Cup Kicks Off Next Week
moments.blurb: The FIH Hockey World Cup 2026 begins next week, August 15-30, in Belgium and the Netherlands, with all Home Nations matches (England, Scotland, Wales) streaming free on Channel 4 Sport YouTube.

angles.name: General Announcement
angles.copy: Get ready for the FIH Hockey World Cup! It starts next Friday, August 15th, and you can watch all England, Scotland, and Wales games FREE on Channel 4 Sport YouTube.

angles.name: Home Nations Derby
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! England Men face Wales Men in a Home Nations showdown at the Hockey World Cup on August 19th. Who are you backing?

moments.title: Roots Picnic London This Weekend
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, today and tomorrow (August 8-9), blending hip hop, music, culture, and community.

angles.name: Today's Event
angles.copy: Roots Picnic touches down in London today! Crystal Palace Bowl is hosting the legendary hip hop and culture festival this weekend. Who's heading down?

angles.name: Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is the place to be this weekend for the Roots Picnic! Two days of world-class hip hop, music, and community vibes in London.

moments.title: Palace Bowl Presents Summer Series
moments.blurb: The Palace Bowl Presents series continues at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, until August 16th, featuring a diverse lineup including Tom Jones, Gary Numan, Bastille, Lenny Kravitz, and Jimmy Eat World.

angles.name: Ongoing Series
angles.copy: Still time to catch some incredible artists at Crystal Palace Bowl's 'Palace Bowl Presents' series, running until August 16th! Who's on your must-see list?

angles.name: Diverse Lineup
angles.copy: From Tom Jones to Gary Numan, Bastille to Lenny Kravitz, Crystal Palace Bowl is bringing the legends to London this summer. What a lineup!
